title: Fresh eyes on the whole dictation flow, phone and desktop, as you use it

chat.text: An Opus reviewer walks the dictation flow headless on the phone and the desktop drawer with a scripted Whisper: New session, four sentences with replies, expand the sheet, the mic indicator, the Refine page; a shot after every gesture, the first-reply time, bubble order, phone and desktop showing the same text. It fixes what it finds and writes the rest as the next brief with the measurement.
